blocker.message: The antecedent owns NodeZero for sem.link and sem.pend_list and knows sem<>0, but NodeZero contains no node-base nonzero fact. The consequent DllInsertAfterCut and NodeStorage require both embedded node bases <>0. eval_addr_expr is abstract; SemaphoreLayout is only an unproved proposition and is absent from the premises, so typed field ownership supplies no bridge to those required base-address facts.
